purpose: Original AI-generated visual concept references for VICE Lifestyle artwork; not game screenshots, not geometry-validation evidence, not measurement sheets.
method: Built-in imagegen tool; original pool generation plus one precise pocket-placement correction; original darts generation.

final_images.review: Main illustration contains six pockets. Player inset's erroneous short-rail centre pocket was removed in v2. Sample ball numerals 8, 1 and 9 readable.
final_images.style: Chunky worn oak, forest-green cloth, restrained brass, simple bevels and broad edge wear.

final_images.review: Main front illustration visually checked: 20 on top; clockwise number sequence 20,1,18,4,13,6,10,15,2,17,3,19,7,16,8,11,14,9,12,5.

limitations: These images guide silhouette, palette and material hierarchy only. Contract geometry, dimensions, axes, pivots, scoring radii, mesh/material names and triangle budgets must be constructed and independently validated in exported assets. Neither image establishes numerical compliance.
